research_gate.rule: No additional external research is required for the bounded Export Freeze capability. A strict compatibility repair discovered during implementation readiness is handled under the existing repair exception.

canonical_parent_state.reason: The qualified validator permits additive EXPORT_RELEASE fields.

reuse: EXPORT_FROZEN->PUBLISHED_OR_DELIVERED separately requires author publication authority
lifecycle_transition.authority_rule: Lifecycle v1 remains the policy/gate authority; Export Freeze must never become a second lifecycle engine.

author_decision_queue.reuse: Author authority remains separate; freeze never synthesizes publication approval.

facts: Lifecycle v1 was qualified against keyed object parent collections.
Current Version/Rollback and Author Decision Queue use sealed array collections.
Lifecycle v1 evidence/author lookup cannot directly consume those arrays.
Lifecycle v1 digestParentState identity is not the current sealed state_digest identity required by Version/Rollback authority-receipt ingestion.
The current Lifecycle runtime facade has no adapter.
compatibility_finding.repair_scope: Representation and parent-identity translation only; no new transitions, gate semantics or authority.

selected_authority_sequence_after_adapte: 1. In FINALIZATION, Export Freeze validates exact manuscript/artifact/profile/proof/rights/privacy/provenance currentness.
2. Export Freeze appends one immutable EXPORT_RELEASE with approval_state=FROZEN, publication_authority_state=NOT_AUTHORIZED and evidence_type=EXPORT_FREEZE_READY; status remains FINALIZATION.
3. Version/Rollback records that parent successor with authority_kind=EXPORT_RELEASE.
4. Qualified current-parent compatibility adapter delegates FINALIZATION->EXPORT_FROZEN gate evaluation to unchanged Lifecycle v1 and returns a current sealed-parent receipt.
5. Version/Rollback records the lifecycle successor under authority_kind=LIFECYCLE_TRANSITION.

release_granularity.multi_format_rule: Optional release_group_ref may group artifacts, but each byte artifact retains its own release_id and digest.

ADD_OR_REFINE: bounded Export Freeze runtime and receipt
UNRESOLVED: Executable Export Freeze remains blocked until BOOK-SYSTEM-LIFECYCLE-CURRENT-PARENT-COMPATIBILITY-ADAPTER-001 passes exact-SHA qualification.

new_freeze_required_when: required proof/validation becomes failed or stale
